g.text: Why do you even use this? You can talk telepathically, right?
Are you asking out of concern, or idle curiosity?
It’s about two things, honestly. Control and art.
Can I suggest you find something else with which to occupy your time?
Look. I was raised to be polite. It’s a Britannic thing.
Because I have to compose every sentence. I don’t just get to dump meaning wholesale into your head.
I am, after all, the very picture of frailty.
Try prancing up to Arthur and asking about his haemorrhoids.
Politeness is all about not letting the other person know how you feel about them.
That would be easy. Lazy. Uninteresting.
Perhaps you'd like to mop my brow as I recline upon my fainting couch?
This is your first and only warning. I am not an exhibit.
Which is hard, when your mind is effectively plugged into theirs.
Telepathy is about as nuanced as a boot up the arse.
I didn't say it was concern for YOU. [End.]
For instance, right now I could be feeling like wrapping your guts around a stick...
Ah! You are being circumspect. Treating me as the fearsome lamia I am.
... or feeling giddy as a schoolgirl because you’re finally talking to me.
Largely because of what it doesn’t say.
You should have met me BEFORE I was infested.
You don’t know. But if this were a telepathic conversation, you would.
So it's about not showing your feelings?
Sounds like you just prefer to hide behind a screen. [End.]
Exactly. Before Höllvania, before the Techrot, I depended on text to make my living. Now it’s just a luxury. A whimsy.
Until I choose to, yes. Perhaps it's silly to try to be civilized in this shithole. But...
Can you blame me for taking every inch of privacy I can get?
Clearly I made the right choice.
To pass the time while I wait for my body to turn into a chimera I barely recognize.
... we all have our little ways of staying sane, don't we?
